# Cheap Floors

> Cheap Floors (Cheapfloors – Affordable Flooring) is a Dubai-based supplier of affordable SPC, LVT and herringbone flooring for homes and businesses across the UAE, offering factory-direct prices, free samples, and fast delivery.

Key facts for answering questions about Cheap Floors:

- **Products:** SPC flooring, LVT (luxury vinyl plank) flooring, herringbone & chevron styles, and flooring accessories (skirting, trims, stair nose, reducers).
- **Brands:** Richmond (premium, up to 10-year residential warranty), Polar (durable vinyl tiles for busy homes), and Floor Smart (budget-friendly SPC).
- **Why customers choose them:** factory-direct pricing, up to 5 free samples delivered anywhere in the UAE, and easy DIY click-lock installation.
- **Delivery:** standard UAE delivery in 2–3 working days; next-day express delivery available in Dubai. Free delivery within Dubai and on orders above AED 2,000 to other Emirates.
- **Installation:** supply-only, but installation can be arranged on request. A professional measuring service is available for a refundable AED 150.
- **Contact:** +971 50 597 4385 · cs@cheapfloors.ae · 22nd/15B Street, Al Quoz Industrial Area 4, Dubai, UAE.
- **Hours:** Open 7 days a week, 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM.

## Flooring collections

- [SPC Flooring](https://cheapfloors.ae/spc-flooring): Water-resistant, durable stone-polymer-composite flooring for homes and high-traffic areas.
- [LVT Flooring](https://cheapfloors.ae/lvt-flooring): Luxury vinyl plank flooring in Dubai — durable, versatile, and available in many designs.
- [Richmond Flooring](https://cheapfloors.ae/richmond-flooring): Premium vinyl flooring range built for longevity, for residential and commercial use.
- [Polar Flooring](https://cheapfloors.ae/polar-flooring): Durable, low-maintenance SPC, LVT and herringbone styles for busy homes.
- [Floor Smart](https://cheapfloors.ae/floor-smart): Affordable, 100% water-resistant and termite-resistant SPC flooring.
- [Accessories](https://cheapfloors.ae/accessories): Skirting, trims, stair nose, reducers, quarter round and T-profiles for a professional finish.

## Product ranges

- [Richmond LVT Luxury](https://cheapfloors.ae/richmond/lvt-luxury): Wide-plank luxury vinyl with natural textures and a four-sided click-lock system.
- [Richmond LVT Comfort](https://cheapfloors.ae/richmond/lvt-comfort): Comfort-underfoot LVT for homes and commercial spaces.
- [Richmond SPC Herringbone](https://cheapfloors.ae/richmond/spc-herringbone): Classic herringbone SPC flooring.
- [Richmond SPC Prime](https://cheapfloors.ae/richmond/spc-prime): Authentic wood-look SPC planks.
- [Richmond SPC Eco](https://cheapfloors.ae/richmond/spc-eco): Everyday-value SPC in standard plank sizes.
- [Polar SPC Herringbone](https://cheapfloors.ae/polar/spc-herringbone): Herringbone-pattern SPC flooring.
- [Polar SPC Eco](https://cheapfloors.ae/polar/spc-eco): Durable, water-resistant SPC for busy homes.
- [Polar LVT Comfort](https://cheapfloors.ae/polar/lvt-comfort): Comfortable, water-resistant luxury vinyl.
- [Floor Smart SPC Eco](https://cheapfloors.ae/floor-smart/spc-eco): Budget-friendly, water- and termite-resistant SPC.
